title: Oil dispenser bottle with silicone brush
text: Oil dispenser bottle with silicone brush. This works so well and helps you to limit the amount of oil.  I use with avocado oil and ONLY brush on clean pans - I don't touch the brush onto food as I don't want to have to wash it as often.  The whole thing comes apart for cleaning.  I put the smaller parts in my culinary (very top of my dishwasher) tray and everything washed well.  It is easy to use - squeeze the bulb and then press over the pan to dispense some drops of oil - then brush if desired.  I just wanted a way to carefully dispense - as opposed to pouring directly from the bottle where I was constantly 'over pouring' and wiping out - a waste of oil!  So far I am very happy with this dispenser and the ease of use and cleaning.  Time will tell.  I would like to find some replacement silicone brushes so you could just pop a new one on if you chose to touch something food wise.  Time will tell, so I always add that I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful!
